name: Canyon Bakehouse Heritage Style White Bread (Gluten-Free)
whyItWorks: Certified gluten-free white bread baked with fine tapioca and brown rice flours into full, sandwich-sized slices. Free from dairy, soy, nuts, and sesame seeds, with only 1g fiber per slice. Gentle and pliable when toasted or fresh.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Lightly toast to enhance texture and aroma. Excellent for deli turkey sandwiches or light buttered toast.
